steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I didn't expect this place to be so spacious.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No way. It looks at most half this size from the outside. Something's wrong here.
Since it's close to the Black Ring's center, the statue's internal space is further enlarged. Time probably doesn't flow normally here either. In this space, all known rules can be distorted.
Hella presses the elevator's button. As expected, nothing happens.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The emergency staircase is over there, follow me.
You soon find the entrance to the emergency staircase. The spikes blocking the entrance have been crushed. It seems like someone passed through it not long ago.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Could it be the blondie's friend? She's gone up to hold Zoya back on her own, Zoya in this state, no less?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That person is powerful enough. Look, the surrounding Corruptors are all ignoring us and moving upward...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It makes sense if the minds of all the monsters in the Black Ring are controlled by the Ring Master. That person has all the attention of the enemies.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm... Who'd have thought that blondie has such a powerful character behind him?
You must hurry up and climb the tower. Zoya is at the top of the statue. The fights will certainly get brutal later, so you must try your best to conserve your stamina.
Open up a path with as little effort as possible. If there's any danger, do not risk it. You can't die here.
